_note: Ritual steps for Umrah mode live guide. Geofence polygons/points MUST be traced from OpenStreetMap (ODbL) — do not guess coordinates. Ṭawāf lap counting stays manual (GPS unreliable near the Kaʿbah). Saʿy auto-lap = alternating geofence entry Ṣafā ↔ Marwah with hysteresis (≥ 60 s and ≥ 300 m path between counts) and one-tap correction.

steps.title: Iḥrām & intention
steps.trigger: manual or flight reminder before mīqāt (airline announces)

steps.title: Talbiyah
steps.trigger: after niyyah until reaching the Kaʿbah

steps.title: Ṭawāf · 7 rounds
notes: between Yemeni corner and Black Stone: Quran 2:201

steps.title: Two rakʿahs
notes: behind Maqām Ibrāhīm if possible; anywhere in the masjid if crowded

steps.title: Saʿy · 7 laps
notes: Ṣafā → Marwah = 1 lap; finish at Marwah
men jog lightly between the green lights

steps.title: Shave or trim
notes: men shave or trim; women trim a fingertip’s length

geofences.gates: array of {number,name,point} from OSM (e.g. Gate 1 King Abdulaziz, Gate 79 King Fahd)
